DefectDescription: Focus-visible ring used --color-gold with 2.82:1 contrast failing WCAG 2.4.13
RemediationApplied: Updated :focus-visible to use var(--color-primary) [5.81:1 contrast] in light mode and var(--color-gold) [8.10:1 contrast] in dark mode

DefectDescription: Light brass text (#B58B50) on ivory background has 2.82:1 contrast failing WCAG 1.4.3 AA
RemediationApplied: Enforced --color-brass-dark (#8F6932 with 4.51:1 contrast) for all brass-colored readable body and subtitle text

DefectDescription: Missing prefers-reduced-motion media query allowing animations for motion-sensitive users
RemediationApplied: Added @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule resetting animation-duration and transition-duration to 0.01ms

DefectDescription: Search modal lacked role=dialog and aria-modal=true failing WCAG 4.1.2
RemediationApplied: Added role=dialog and aria-modal=true and aria-label=Global Islamic Search to the modal overlay

DefectDescription: Search modal did not trap Tab focus allowing keyboard focus to leak to background elements
RemediationApplied: Implemented keyboard focus trap cycling between first and last focusable elements within the search modal

DefectDescription: Pressing Escape key while typing in search input did not close search modal
RemediationApplied: Attached Escape key listener to close search modal and return focus to previous active trigger element

DefectDescription: Language selector modal lacked role=dialog and aria-modal=true and focus trapping
RemediationApplied: Added dialog semantics and focus trap to language selection modal with Escape key handling

DefectDescription: UniversalSearch lacked index coverage for Seerah Sahaba Prophets and Islamic History monographs
RemediationApplied: Indexed all 25 Seerah chapters 14 Sahaba biographies 10 Prophetic stories and 12 Historical eras in UniversalSearch

DefectDescription: Header buttons (.btn-icon and .mobile-menu-btn) had 40x40px sizing below recommended 44x44px touch area
RemediationApplied: Added min-width: 44px and min-height: 44px on mobile breakpoints to ensure comfortable thumb touch interaction

DefectDescription: Body text stretched full card width on ultrawide monitors exceeding optimal reading measure
RemediationApplied: Added .article-prose and .monograph-body utility classes enforcing optimal reading measure (max-width: 72ch)

DefectDescription: Popular Surah quick access pills in search modal had cramped touch areas on small screens
RemediationApplied: Enhanced quick pills with 8px 12px padding and min-height 36px with clear flex-wrap spacing

DefectDescription: Mobile navigation drawer did not restore focus to hamburger trigger button when closed
RemediationApplied: Stored drawer trigger element reference and restored keyboard focus upon drawer close

DefectDescription: Dense numerical inputs and tables required horizontal overflow safeguards for 320px viewports
RemediationApplied: Verified input full-width scaling and added overflow-x: auto wrapper for complex financial tables

DefectDescription: Arabic Tashkeel and Nastaliq Urdu required sufficient vertical line-height to avoid glyph clipping
RemediationApplied: Audited line-height: 2.0-2.4 for Arabic and 1.8-2.2 for Urdu across all 25 pages
